name: Marketing Launchpad Part-time Digital Marketing Course
description: The Part-time Marketing Launchpad by Kraftshala is India's best part-time online digital marketing course with placements up to 9.5 LPA in top companies. It's an 11-month course with an 8-week paid internship and full-time jobs.

mainEntity.name: What will my typical week look like?

acceptedAnswer.text: You'll attend classes on Sundays (10AM–7PM) and have 2-hour sessions on Tuesday and Thursday evenings for projects or live classes.

mainEntity.name: Will I get any live campaign experience?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you'll run live campaigns on Meta and Google Ads as part of your group project during the program.

mainEntity.name: Is the course curriculum different for Part-Time batch Vs Full-Time Batch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Part-Time course excludes SEO but includes more revision sessions. SEO materials may be shared for self-study.

mainEntity.name: What is the eligibility criteria for Kraftshala's online digital marketing course with placement?

acceptedAnswer.text: You must be 12th pass, have a laptop, internet access, English skills, and be ready to take up a full-time job post course.

mainEntity.name: Is the Marketing Launchpad a job guarantee digital marketing course?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's not a job guarantee program, but if not placed at ₹4.5L+ in 15 months, 60% of the fee is refunded (T&Cs apply).

mainEntity.name: What are the terms and conditions for a refund?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you're not placed at ₹4.5L+ within 15 months of course completion, 60% of your fee is refunded as per T&Cs.

mainEntity.name: Do I directly get a job of 4.5L+ or do I get to do an internship first?

acceptedAnswer.text: Half get direct jobs; others start with internships that often convert to full-time roles of ₹4.5L+.
